LOCAL IMAGES / IMAGE URL LIST

Test image sequences

Load static images without displaying them, screen ordered pairs, or play a repeatable shuffled sequence. Pair tests cover alternating A/B sequences at the selected rate and size. They cannot prove that every multi-image trajectory passes WCAG.

Local files stay in this browser. URL images are requested from their hosts without credentials; the host must permit CORS pixel access. Load up to 32 static PNG/JPEG/WebP files, each at most 20 MB and 16 megapixels. Animated formats are rejected. Pair screening accepts up to 12 loaded images. Load replaces the previous set and combines selected files with listed URLs.

Images are centered with contain sizing on black. Numerical screening uses an sRGB canvas reduced to at most 64 pixels per side, preserving the selected display aspect ratio mapped to these dimensions, with browser smoothing. Tiny details can disappear. Playback uses the stated CSS dimensions without scaling to fit. Test default size and the largest presentation size; use tab capture separately for actual rendered evidence.

Warning: live playback can trigger seizures, migraines, dizziness or nausea. Numerical screening does not require playback. Brief duration and Stop controls do not make exposure safe.
